generation.explanation: The graph of \(y=\tan x\) repeats every \(\pi\) and has vertical asymptotes wherever \(\cos x=0\), at \(x=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\). On \([-2\pi,2\pi]\), these occur at \(-\frac{3\pi}{2},-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}\); the curve approaches but never reaches them because tangent is undefined there.
